news.title: Apple Says iPhone Duo Demand Extraordinary After Delivery Delays
news.summary: Apple Inc. said demand for the new iPhone Duo has been “nothing short of extraordinary” after shipping estimates slipped to the end of January of next year just minutes after pre-orders opened on Friday.

news.title: JP Morgan Strategist on AI Jitters, Investing Outlook
news.summary: Jordan Jackson, JPMorgan Asset Management Global Market Strategist, discusses whether earnings growth may be nearing a peak even if results are not worsening. Jackson agrees that third-quarter results are expected to be strong, with forecasts calling for about 27% to 28% year-over-year earnings growth. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: OpenAI Poaches Another SpaceX Sales Lead Focused on AI

news.title: CoreWeave Stock Wipeout Exposes Divide Between AI Fear and Greed

news.title: Apple Names Meta Veteran as Litigation Chief in Legal Team Shake-Up

news.title: Anthropic Signs First Data-Center Deal in Canada With EverWind

news.title: Thomas Hoenig on Rate Hikes, Inflation Outlook
news.summary: Thomas Hoenig said Kevin Warsh’s refusal to signal the Fed’s next move was appropriate and gives policymakers flexibility ahead of the late-October meeting. Hoenig noted that inflation has risen and could climb further, citing energy costs and their spillover into core prices. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: Financing The AI Boom: Masters in Business with Bob Michele

They discuss Bob's unconventional start at the University of Pennsylvania, the differences between the science of bonds and the art of equities, and whether the US is heading toward a recession. (Source: Bloomberg)

(Source: Bloomberg)

(Source: Bloomberg)

(Source: Bloomberg)
